double-disc-gate-valves.title: Double Disc Gate Valves
description: Double Disc Gate Valves for Superior Gas Isolation:

Our Double Disc Gate Valves boast a fabricated construction, catering to the isolation needs of gas/air applications. When faced with dirty media and the requirement for a high degree of isolation, our valves emerge as the preferred choice. The metal-to-metal sealing with wedging action ensures a superior degree of isolation, with hard-faced seating surfaces on both the disc and body.

Featuring a unique wedge arrangement, a small wedge fits between two-disc plates, providing flexibility for seating. Upon valve closure, the two-disc plates adjust their position to achieve perfect contact with the body seat. During opening, the disc plates collapse, allowing the disc assembly to move freely out of the bore.
specifications: Three Lever Shut Off Damper Valves

fire-damper-valves.title: Fire Damper Valves
description: Bellator Engineers manufactures a comprehensive range of Fire Damper Valves (FDV) in sizes from 200 mm to 1600 mm in Round and Square/Rectangular Shape and Pressure rating up to 10” WC. Fire dampers are passive fire protection products used in heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) ducts to prevent the spread of fire inside the ductwork through fire-resistance rated walls and floors. Fire/smoke dampers are similar to fire dampers in fire resistance rating, and also prevent the spread of smoke inside the ducts. When a rise in temperature occurs, the fire damper closes, usually activated by a thermal element which melts at temperatures higher than ambient but low enough to indicate the presence of a fire, allowing springs to close the damper blades. Fire dampers can also close following receipt of an electrical signal from a fire alarm system utilizing detectors remote from the damper, indicating the sensing of heat or smoke in the building occupied spaces or in the HVAC duct system. They are mainly designed for Ventilation systems. Our Selection Criteria of actuators for automation is mainly based on the Torque values derived from the dynamic conditionsof process parameters to ensure the genuine selection and flawless operation of damper valves.
Standard :- National Fire Protection Association (NFPA 80, 90A, and 101) / International Building Code (IBC) / UL-555
Ends :- Valves End Flange Dimensions ASME B16.5/ ASME B 16.47 / IS 6392 / EN 1092-1 / Mfg. STD
specifications: Three Lever Shut Off Damper Valves
